description: This file defines a singleton repository 'ShopRepository' providing access to product categories, product data, cart management, recent searches, and catalog preferences for an online shopping app. It includes in-memory data structures, LiveData for reactive UI updates, and persistent storage interactions via a LocalStore.

classes.name: ShopRepository.CatalogPreferences
classes.description: Stores user-selected catalog filters and sorting options.

classes.name: ShopRepository.CartItem
classes.description: Represents a product and its quantity in the cart, with helper methods for total calculations.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Returns the list of available product categories.

methods.name: getAllProducts
methods.description: Returns the complete list of products.

methods.name: findProductById
methods.description: Finds a product by its ID.

methods.name: getCategoryName
methods.description: Returns the name of a category given its ID.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the repository, restoring persisted state from local storage using the application context.

methods.name: cartLiveData
methods.description: Provides LiveData reflecting the current cart state.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds a specified quantity of a product to the cart.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity for a specific product in the cart, removing it if the quantity is zero or less.

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart.

methods.name: cartItems
methods.description: Returns a list of CartItems representing current cart contents.

methods.name: cartTotalCents
methods.description: Calculates the total price of the cart in cents.

methods.name: getRecentSearches
methods.description: Returns the list of recent search queries.

methods.name: recordSearchQuery
methods.description: Records a new search query, maintaining a capped, de-duplicated list, and persists it.

methods.name: clearRecentSearches
methods.description: Clears all recent searches and updates persistence.

methods.name: loadCatalogPreferences
methods.description: Loads catalog filter/sort preferences from local storage, with defaults.

methods.name: publishCart
methods.description: Updates LiveData with current cart state and persists the cart.
